basis.contact_limit: Use the minimum parent-material yield screen applying to either side of each contact pair. Retain the R3 250 MPa bound.
basis.fit_assumptions: Project allocation for machined, matched faces and guide registration. Use independent effective axial stiffness samples about E divided by the gross axial stack; no measured stiffness or manufacturing capability is implied.

local_contact_and_material.reason: Certified through-section properties, hardness, edge stress, roughness, fatigue, impact, local backing and reaction-head compliance require qualification.

installed_fit_and_actuation.reason: Installed guide and actuator design, measured axial take-up, local flatness, preload, and loaded seat-to-key clearance need verification.
